sloka: यया पुत्रः च भर्ता च त्यक्ताव् ऐश्वर्य कारणात् ।कम् सा परिहरेद् अन्यम् कैकेयी कुल पाम्सनी ॥२-४८-२२॥
transliteration: yayā putraḥ ca bhartā ca tyaktāv aiśvarya kāraṇāt ।kam sā parihared anyam kaikeyī kula pāmsanī ॥2-48-22॥

translations.english: Can Kaikeyi, who has brought disgrace to the race by abandoning her husband and son for the sake of wealth, spare others?
